items.title: Can Leidos Holdings (LDOS) Justify Its Price On Earnings?
items.summary: Leidos Holdings has seen its share price move around in recent years, and the stock now trades near US$128, which puts the spotlight squarely on what investors are paying for its earnings. With new contract wins refreshing the story, the key question is whether the current valuation aligns with what the business is actually earning today. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 55.7%, which places meaningful expectations on how strongly Leidos' profits can justify that longer term...

items.title: Leidos Holdings (LDOS) Could Be 15% Undervalued After Its Conference Spotlight
items.summary: Leidos Holdings (LDOS) is back in focus after the company confirmed plans to join the Goldman Sachs 2026 Industrials and Materials Conference, where CEO Tom Bell will take part in a live investor Q&A session. Recent trading tells a mixed story for Leidos Holdings. The share price closed at US$128.37 after a 1-day share price return of 3.97%. However, the 30-day and year to date share price returns are down 5.67% and 30.03% respectively, while the 5-year total shareholder return of 55.68%...
